title: AI Scams, Fintech Dark Patterns & Consumer Rights 🛡️
description: Deepfake voice scams, QR code scams, instant loan app traps, and RBI Cyber Helpline (1930).

cards.title: AI Voice Cloning Scams 🤖
cards.content:
Scammers 3-second audio clip se dost ya family member ki voice clone kar rahe hain — "Accident ho gaya, jaldi ₹20,000 UPI karo!".

Golden Rule: **Code Word Strategy!** Family ke saath Secret Code Word fix karo.
cards.imagePrompt: Robot mask next to phone speaker warning waveform, red cyber theme

choiceData.scenario: Dost ki same aawaz waala call aaya — urgent ₹15,000 accident hospital payment request. Action?

choices.consequence: Scam Victims Alert! Voice AI clone thi, ₹15,000 lost.

choices.text: Call cut karke dost ke direct phone/family member ko re-verify karo
choices.consequence: Saved! Direct call pe dost hostel mein safe nikla.

cards.title: QR Code Payment Myth 📲
cards.content:
**MYTH**: Money receive karne ke liye QR scan karna padta hai.
**FACT**: QR Code SCAN / PIN enter karne se sirf PAISA JAATA HAI, kabhi AATA NAHI!
cards.imagePrompt: Red QR code with prohibition cross badge

quizData.question: OLX buyer bol raha hai ki paise RECEIVE karne ke liye UPI PIN dalo. Safe hai?
options: Haan, PIN receive ke liye hota hai
Nahi! PIN se sirf paise DEDUCT hote hain
quizData.explanation: UPI PIN is ONLY for sending money. Receiving money NEVER needs PIN or QR scan!

cards.title: 🚨 MISSION: Cyber Crime Emergency Setup
cards.content:
🚨 **TODAY'S MISSION**

- [ ] Family ke saath Secret Safety Password/Code word fix karo.
- [ ] Bank app mein International/Contactless limit disable karo.
- [ ] Unknown instant loan apps uninstall karo.
